title: EndpointId
description: The name of an endpoint's own Ed25519 key pair, derived from the public key exactly as a PeerId is from the node's: the libp2p identity multihash over the protobuf-encoded public key, written in canonical base58btc. It is NOT a second PeerId, a human identity, an organizational role, or an authorization principal. Received from the network it is peer-asserted routing metadata: a remote source_endpoint proves only that the authenticated PeerId claimed that endpoint. Derived, never chosen: a value that is not the canonical encoding of an Ed25519 key is refused as EndpointIdNotDerived.
